entries.title: Fixed Spiral Curtain and Open Header Roll Shutter
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed half-raised roll-shutter doorway with an intentionally open-front header. One uninterrupted finite-thickness curtain runs from its full lower bar up through two straight inward-open C-section jamb guides and continues into a true one-and-a-half-turn separated spiral around the entire upper barrel. The straight curtain has shallow geometric corrugations and the roll has real layer gaps, not a cylinder placed above an unrelated flat panel. A complete upper shaft and both full bearing sleeves sit in two entire side cheeks, joined by a back plate and proud roof cap; the header front is deliberately absent to expose the winding geometry. A full threshold and two lower captive shoe appearances complete the same one doorway. All material surfaces and profiles newly authored, no old door/screen mesh imported. Unlike the complete sectional door with ten independent panels, side rollers and tracks turning into long horizontal overhead returns, this has a continuous coiled curtain retained by straight jamb channels and a compact winding head. Unlike the tripod projection screen, no mast, tripod or upward blank display sheet is used. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and full horizontal-bounds-centred ground datum. entries.title: Fixed Horizontal Twin Comb and Loop Grip Trimmer
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed twin-comb hedge-trimmer-style exterior. A low long axial housing connects an open rear holding frame to a short front gear-case exterior. The plates are held in one fixed separated pose, rooted at the nose, not an animated cutting mechanism. A whole broad front wrap grip and separate finite shield flank the low housing.
